resolution: Implemented the previously fictional Follow workflow as a real live-editor and Agent Seat capability. The native host now emits an exact read-only local patch for the current or supplied render triangles, including welded vertices, authored groups, part/material/semantic identity, adjacency rings, and propagation frontiers. Agent Seat persists a short-lived Follow session through hot reload, records accepted human Merge Faces selections before and after their group-only commit, excludes automation from demonstrations, exposes start/read/stop/clear/inspect through tools/seat, and documents the runnable no-source-exploration workflow in the local skill. Verified with test-mesh-edit, 31 Seat API tests, node syntax validation, and a ReleaseFast editor build; no model assets were committed.
